answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the horizon index resolves every citation against the canyon checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the saffron audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 81 aliases therefore burns the authoring cost 81 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
